native_parity.scope: Archived pre-refactor headless native-off traces (stage 3) versus current headless native-off traces, using the full ordered mechanics, root-motion and collision comparator.
interpretation: Time is relative to episode_start. Actor lifetime IDs are mapped to start actor/target roles; absolute game clocks and IDs are not expected to match.
34 ms is one fixed 30 Hz step; 2 cm and 0.5 degrees bound trajectory drift. This does not permit different choices, damage or terminal outcomes.
Animation windows are engine guard predicates. Censored intervals remain censored; an unexercised guard is reported as unexercised.

Native source nondeterminism may make a historical trace diverge. Report the first ordered mismatch, reproduce it with the archived binary/same-source render, and isolate the cause; never loosen limits after a failed measurement.

limitations: No neural model or training is part of this stage.
Fixture mutations establish test states; all action execution, animation, collision and damage use the native engine.
Continue is a continuation of an existing segment and does not claim a new animation start.
Wall watchdog timing is measured independently from simulation time.
